Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
"Madman2001" <Mad...@madman.com> wrote:
> From a careful reading of 5th Tradition, I have concluded that
> the target vampire (the one who gets filled to capacity) can
> be in torpor. True??

True. The card requires the target to be controlled, not just ready.
Which means that the vampire may not be in the uncontrolled region or
contested. It also doesn't specify that it must be controlled by the
person playing the card, so you can also choose a vampire controlled by
another player.

>
> Dear Sirs:

>
> From a careful reading of 5th Tradition, I have concluded that the
> target vampire (the one who gets filled to capacity) can be in torpor.

True.

Effects that affect X can affect any X in play (in torpor or not),
subject to any further restrictions in the card text, of course.
